plugins.name: Plugin Hub
plugins.author: jamescfer
plugins.description: This hub. Installs the DDO plugins and can run them inside itself, so they don't each need an icon on the DungeonHelper bar.

plugins.name: Power Level
plugins.author: jamescfer
plugins.description: Party DPS / power-level overlay with per-difficulty and per-level community comparisons.

plugins.name: Loot Tracker
plugins.author: jamescfer
plugins.description: Records chest loot into a shared database of drop locations and drop rates, with an item lookup.

plugins.name: Quest XP
plugins.author: jamescfer
plugins.description: Tracks quest XP and run time into a shared database, ranked by XP per minute per level.

plugins.name: Code Caller
plugins.author: jamescfer
plugins.description: Sends chat codes to NPCs in an ordered, range-gated sequence, with import/export.

plugins.name: Aggro Watch
plugins.author: jamescfer
plugins.description: Shows which player, hireling or pet each nearby monster is targeting, with pull attribution.

plugins.name: Player Assistant
plugins.author: jamescfer
plugins.description: Combat assistant: DC caster and healer automation that reads your hotbars.

plugins.name: Empty the TR Cache
plugins.author: jamescfer
plugins.description: Moves items out of the reincarnation cache into your bank (duplicates first), then your backpack.
